the acetylation of TopA is an important physiological mechanism to modulate the level of negative supercoiling, and that the CobB protein is a major deacetylase that protects the cell from negative supercoiling induced by excess lysine acetyl modification of TopA.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CobB is a key enzyme that maintains negative supercoiling homeostasis by regulating TopA activity.
